name: InitializeDosRuntime

Initializes DS to 1676, establishes stack, resizes DOS allocation, parses environment/command line, clears BSS, then calls RunGameSessionLoop. The original DIET stub was independently emulated to this instruction; all 30076 initialized module bytes matched. Decompiler stack recovery remains incomplete; this is not recovered source.

name: LoadTrekDataArchive

Initializes buffered input, reads two little-endian words per record, allocates record storage, writes size difference, and calls DecodeLzsBlock. Ends on shared input/error state; exact record semantics and EOF treatment are not yet reconstructed.

name: LoadRoadByIndex
plate_comment: Opens DS:0e08 ('roads.lzs'). Seeks index*4, reads uint16 file offset and uint16 decoded length, then seeks to block. Reads 3 uint16 metadata fields into DS:4562/54a2/4566; copies 216 bytes to DS:41c2, then decodes length bytes into far pointer DS:162c. Clears 7000-byte destination first; returns decoded_length/14. Metadata field meanings and tile bit layout remain unverified.

name: RunRoadSession
plate_comment: Road wrapper installs/clears keyboard held bits, initializes HUD caches, sets up drawings, calls RunGameplayLoop. Result0 showsRoad completed orThe End according callerflag, then4459 waits27 timer increments. BIOS-key helper4153 only sets54a0 whenaf32 enabled; normalaf32=0 keys do not dismiss. Restores IRQ09 vector and returns result. Main caller branch semantics verified separately: failures1..6 retry same archive;0 increments30-wordcompletion array andselectedindex;7 returnsselection. Synthetic finish+notice/full progression cases and six failed attempts verified; assets/disk writes virtualized.

name: RunGameplayLoop
plate_comment: Verified whole init/input/HUD/wait/gameplay cycle in6926 wait boundaries across31 archives plus26 paused busy-poll cases. Core5370 tick corpus remains unchanged. Starts forward3<<16,lateral32768,height10240,speed0,fuel/oxygen30000. Three BP words are unspecified and explicitly seeded;270 original frames show other state independent of six seeds. Normal inputs poll074c after22f8 timer wait and before catch-up; P/Escape checked after preceding physics at next outer loop. P waits release,any key press,all release, then restores saved timer. Failure gate waits crash_ticks==0 or>42 and reason1/2,reason3 with crash,or end_ticks>=108. Finish calls0f05 without incrementing processed counter. Draw calls virtualized but HUD/sound writes execute. Nominal36.00428485Hz local JS has same integer state/traces; physical DOS/OS latency not yet measured. CYCLE-FORMAT.md.

comments.pre_comment: Verified tick boundary after input polling. Main BP frame and nine persistent local words are required; this is not a standalone function entry.
Verification stops here after incrementing BP-02. Outer tick catch-up/render scheduling is outside the recovered tick model.

name: InstallTimerHandlers
plate_comment: Installs IRQ08h handler at CS:3b17 and INT24h handler at CS:3b14; preserves the old IRQ08h vector in self-modified far-jump operands CS:3b67/3b69. Programs PIT channel 0 in mode 3 with divisor 0x19e4 (6628). IRQ phase DS:3192 counts 9..0; gameplay counter DS:1600 increments at phases 5 and 0, so one physics counter increment every five IRQs. Nominal PC PIT clock 1193182 Hz yields 180.0214 IRQ/s and 36.0043 physics ticks/s. Clock frequency is an emulator/PC model, not a measurement. Verified installer port/IVT writes and 1324 phase/stream IRQ cases against original code; analysis/skyroads/timer-validation.json.

name: OpenFileReadOnly

name: PrintConsoleString
plate_comment: Walks NUL-terminated string and calls WriteConsoleCharacter. Uses DS-relative near pointer.

name: WriteConsoleCharacter
plate_comment: DOS INT21 AH=02h, DL=character. Emits carriage return before newline (LF) to produce CRLF.

name: ProbeEgaSupport
plate_comment: BIOS INT10 AH=12h BL=10h; returns true if BL was changed and is at least3. Name describes use as fallback EGA support check; hardware behavior not exercised.

name: ProbeVgaSupport
plate_comment: BIOS INT10 AX=1a00h; requires returned AL=1ah and BL in[7,8], the VGA display-combination codes. Hardware behavior not exercised.

name: InitializeBufferedInput
plate_comment: Stores input handle at DS:41ac, prepares buffer via63f0, refills via6364, resets bitreader/EOF flags. Used by archive and road loading.

name: ReadBufferedWordLE
plate_comment: Calls ReadBufferedByte twice and combines first byte as low8bits, second as high8bits.

name: ReadBufferedByte
plate_comment: Reads current buffered byte from DS:41b0 then advances/refills using6326. Current return type is broader than meaningful low8bits.

name: ReadBufferedBitMSB
plate_comment: Returns highest bit of current byte, shifts left, decrements remaining count DS:41ae and loads next byte when count reaches0.

name: ReadBufferedBitsMSB
plate_comment: Consumes requested number of MSB-first bits, accumulates result in AX. Current decompiler incorrectly infers void return; register semantics verified in raw instructions. Do not treat current prototype as recovered ABI.

name: DecodeLzsBlock
plate_comment: Verified resource decoder: Python port matched all31 ROADS.LZS streams (60872 bytes) against isolated replay of these unchanged x86 instructions. Header bytes are length_bits, short_distance_bits, long_distance_bits. MSB-first tokens: 0=short match(distance=read(short)+2), 10=long match(distance=read(long)+(1<<short)+2), 11=8-bit literal. Match length=read(length_bits)+2; overlapping forward copy. Patches widths at6729,671f,674c and long-distance base at6751. Far destination BP+4, output length BP+8. Buffer byte alignment on exit. Runtime helpers require SS=DS. Python rejects malformed streams more strictly than original; equivalence is verified on the31 valid road streams, not all possible inputs. See analysis/skyroads/lzs-validation.json.

name: AlignBufferedInputToByte
plate_comment: If remaining bit count is not8, consumes that count through ReadBufferedBitsMSB. Used after decoded blocks.

name: GetRoadTileAtPosition
plate_comment: Verified in collision-validation.json against unchanged x86 using 31 roads. Near-stack ABI: uint32 forward at BP+4/+6; uint16 lateral BP+8. u=uint16(lateral/128-95); u>=322 returns0. Column=u/46; row=forward/65536. DS-near address arithmetic wraps16 bits. No row bounds check. Loader clears7000-byte road allocation before filling decoded bytes; standalone model bounds this allocation.

name: ApplyRoadSurfaceEffect
plate_comment: Surface helper verified as part of5370-tick corpus including matrix of16 surfaces x6 profiles x3 heights. Uses low nibble:2 subtracts303 speed unless crash active;10 adds303 unless crash active;9 refills resources5494/B13c to30000 if no exit, requesting sound4 when either<27000;12 sets exit2 if no exit and crash1 if no crash, requesting sound0. Always signed-clamps32-bit speed54ac/54ae to0..10922. Upper surface selection is performed by caller. See skyroads_tick.py, TICK-FORMAT.md and tick-validation.json.

name: GetRoadSupportHeight
plate_comment: Verified original-code comparison. Reads tile; bits0..3 ground surface, bits8..11 structure. If structure0 OR force_ground argument BP+10!=0: ground0=>0, otherwise2800h. Structure1 has no flat support (returns0); structures2/3=>3200h,4/5=>3c00h. Table DS:e4. Caller uses tunnel midline flag to force ground support; this flag is not a collision-free guarantee.

name: IsBelowTunnelMidline

At index<38, returns uint16(height-2200h)/128 < (lower[index]+upper[index])/2. Tables at DS:4c and98,38 uint16 entries each. This is a tunnel-context heuristic used by rendering/support selection, NOT a complete empty-space/collision test.

name: TestStructureCollision
plate_comment: Verified raw AX against boundary/random cases. Stack args tile BP+4,index BP+6,height BP+8. index>=38=>0; q=uint16(height-2200h)/128; s=tile&f00h. s100: lower[index]<=q<upper[index]. s200: height<3200h. s300: height<3200h AND lower<=q. s400: height<3c00h. s500: height<3c00h AND lower<=q. Unknown s returns masked s unchanged (non-boolean AX); shipped roads only use structures0..5. Preserve16-bit wrap and unsigned comparisons.

name: TestPositionCollision
plate_comment: Verified original-code comparison including actual31-road cases. Samples tile ground at lateral +/-700h. Ground collision if either ground nibble nonzero AND height<2800h AND uint16(height+600h)>2480h. Structure path requires uint16(height+680h)>2800h and nonzero structure at side sample. Tests center structure with folded index, then adjacent column +/-1700h with index47-folded. Near-stack uint32 forward BP+4/+6,lateral BP+8,height BP+10. Movement resolver186b and full physics are outside current verification.

name: IsUnsafeLandingTile
plate_comment: Verified all ground/top nibble combinations for structures0..5 against original. Structure1 returns0. Otherwise effective surface=(structure? tile>>4:tile)&f. Returns1 for no ground at structure0, or surface12. Called by jump-landing predictor1ccd. Returns a filter result, not a complete guarantee of safe landing. Confirms bits4..7 select upper surface for structured tiles.

name: ResolveShipMovement
plate_comment: Verified integer port in scripts/skyroads_movement.py, differential evidence in movement-validation.json (1970 resolver cases; every intermediate collision probe compared). Near C arguments: targetForwardLow, targetForwardHigh, targetLateral, targetHeight. Reads/writes DS:9618/961a forward32, DS:af1c lateral16, DS:af2c height16. Five fractional movement probes; keeps the last clear fraction; refines forward by4096/256/16/1, then lateral and height by signed125/25/5/1. Fractional lateral/height products wrap16 BEFORE signed division by5; forward product wraps32. Division truncates toward zero. Axis order is observable. Forward refinement uses an unsigned remaining distance and assumes ordinary forward motion. Host port bounds road allocation/probes; no general swept-collision or full game-loop equivalence claim.

name: PredictSafeLanding
plate_comment: Verified integer port and complete projected-flight traces (1408 direct prediction cases plus calls inside519 assist cases). Near C args: forward32, lateral16, height16, speed32, signedSteering16, signedVerticalSpeed16. Uses DS:54aa gravity, DS:5496 lateral drift, DS:9330 acceleration input. Each step adds gravity to vertical speed, advances forward by current speed, lateral by signed32((speed+1560)*steering)/512+drift, rejects x outside inclusive12160..53376, adds vertical speed to height, clamps speed+75*input to0..10922. Stops at unsigned height<=10240, then tests previous/current tiles with IsUnsafeLandingTile. Does not execute collision resolution or test intermediate walls/roofs. AX=0/1; globals unchanged. See MOVEMENT-FORMAT.md.

name: AdjustJumpForSafeLanding
plate_comment: Verified against unchanged x86, including candidate order and all prediction traces (519 direct cases). Tests current projected landing first. If unsafe, for n=1..6 tries steering +/- trunc16(steering*n)/10, then speed +/- trunc32(speed*n)/10. Faster candidate tested only if signed speed<10922 (strict); first accepted candidate wins. Uses current position, vertical speed and environment globals. Writes steering DS:4568, speed DS:54ac/54ae, speed delta DS:af2e/af30, success flag DS:455a. An immediately safe prediction preserves existing flag/delta. Exhausting trials restores original steering/speed, writes delta0 and preserves flag. Helper purpose supported by caller and exact replay; gameplay triggering conditions remain to be reconstructed.

name: HandleTimerInterrupt
plate_comment: IRQ08h handler recovered from InstallTimerHandlers vector. Preserves general registers and DS, sets DS from relocated CS:3aca, then calls audio stream service 5a55. When byte DS:3192 is 0 or 5, increments word DS:1600 and feeds the speaker PIT from word [DS:bd0], advancing that pointer for nonzero words. Decrements phase; signed-negative result resets phase to 9 and far-jumps to old BIOS handler via CS:3b67/3b69. Other phases emit PIC EOI and IRET. Normal 9..0 cycle has one gameplay tick each 5 IRQs and one BIOS chain each 10. All 256 phase byte values, counter wrap, port outputs and restored registers compared; audio service idle-delay branch only, old BIOS execution excluded. See timer-validation.json and TIMER-FORMAT.md.
